amendment: v2: reserved identifier text renamed document in pf-ner; runner persists partial failures. See research/protocol-amendments.md; no endpoint, cap, seed or census changes.
scope: Bounded synthetic resource analysis of authored external cost projections, not original application execution or provider-token bounds.
primary_endpoints: per-projection compiler vs structural max/sum/multiply bounds
baselines: competent structural max/sum/multiply on shared primitive IR facts
inference: No p-values or population confidence claims; report each workflow and retain failures. Repeated seeds are not independent application samples.
failure_policy: All 11 projections must check, emit parseable reports/IR, match structural bounds and expected maximum call counts. Infrastructure failures are not unsafe rejections. Bound violations fail the run. No exclusions or cap changes after freeze.
limitations: Input/output caps and some guards are introduced deployment annotations. Concurrency, return-value construction and SDK/provider behavior may be removed; every change is recorded. Zero original workflow executions and zero faithful end-to-end translations. No privacy claim is established by this corpus.
